Survive the Ghosts

Keep your pet alive and away from the ghosts for as long as you can. Look after the gauges, turn the lights off to sleep at night, and tap ghosts away. The longer you last, the higher your rank.

Tap x1 at the top to speed up time. New here? Read How to play first.

Settings

One set of pet art is used for every stage; the pet grows larger with age. The game pauses while this page is open. Poses you do not upload fall back to the nearest pose or the built-in art.

  • PNG with a transparent background (or JPG, WebP), max 4 MB
  • Square image, 512 × 512 px recommended (auto-resized to 256 px)
  • Keep the pet centered with about 10% margin (green dashed frame)
  • Face the pet forward; every pose uses the same size and position
  • 6 poses: Normal, Happy, Scared, Shocked, Sleeping, Hurt
